Career Compass multi-agent edition

Version 0.7.1 · November 3, 2026 · Multi-agent edition. GitHub Pages serves the interface; a separate backend runs the agent team.

One chat, a specialist team

A model-driven coordinator delegates bounded tasks to independent resume, interview and career planning loops, then combines successful findings. Each specialist has separate instructions and restricted tools. Simple greetings can be handled by the coordinator alone.

RAG and actual actions

Specialists retrieve local guidance before generating findings. Source IDs are validated at both layers. Expand Sources and agent activity below replies to inspect actual actions, rather than private model reasoning.

Limits and privacy

At most 16 model calls and three specialist consultations per request, with a 120-second HTTP timeout. Multiple agents may increase latency and token usage. Source validation does not prove factual accuracy, relevance or perfect prompt-injection resistance. Messages, documents, history, context and guidance are sent to OpenAI. Use redacted data. Keys remain on the local server; chats remain in browser storage until deleted.

Validation and remaining work

118 automated tests pass. Five small fictional live checks cover interview drafting, a combined resume/plan request, a topic change, a document instruction attack and a greeting. They are development checks, not a held-out benchmark or proof of student outcomes. Student testing, broader answer-quality comparison and the final presentation remain. Verify the live backend status and an actual reply after deployment.
